definitions.explanation: Tending to speak little; reserved in speech. Describes a personality trait of not talking much.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無口|むくち}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦で→だ：09496_da⟧、⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦{話|はな}さない→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: He's a quiet person and hardly speaks even in meetings.

examples.japanese: {無口|むくち}⟦だけど→だけど：00033_dakedo⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦きちんと→きちんと：00222_kichinto⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He's taciturn, but he does his work properly.
My father was a man of few words and didn't talk much even at home.

notes:
USAGE:
Describes a personality trait rather than temporary silence.
・{無口|むくち}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧/⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (a quiet person/personality)
・{無口|むくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become quiet - e.g., after something happens)

NUANCE:
Generally neutral to slightly negative. Unlike "quiet" in English, {無口|むくち} specifically refers to not speaking much, not to being calm or peaceful.

CONTRAST:
・{無口|むくち} ↔ ⟦おしゃべり→お喋り：01911_oshaberi⟧ (taciturn ↔ talkative)
・{無口|むくち} ↔ ⟦{饒舌|じょうぜつ}→饒舌：08651_jouzetsu⟧ (taciturn ↔ loquacious - more formal)

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
・{無|む} (without) + ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth) = without [use of] mouth → not talkative
